title: Figurehead
tagline: Every ship has a face. Every voyage leaves a mark.
teaser: Live the whole life of one frigate, from her launch to her last passage home: twelve chapters over thirty years. Take prizes whole and choose their prize crews by the six-to-one rule, make captains of your officers, and wear every battle's scars. Lose her, and the carving at her bow sails on.

manPage.synopsis: figurehead — sail one ship through her whole life, and bring her prizes home.
manPage.description: A reborn sail, Dave Riggle's 1980 game of fighting sail from BSD Unix, with Ed Wang's and Craig Leres's later work. Its rules are kept, from the wind table to the six-to-one rule for prisoners; around them, a ship's life of twelve chapters, prizes that join her squadron, scars that stay, and a carving that outlives her hulls.

howToPlay: Pick a dot on the chart to steer; the rose shows how far she can sail on each heading.
Fire what bears, then make it so; rake from ahead or astern for the heaviest broadside.
Bring prizes home with enough hands: one for every six prisoners, two more to keep her.
